description: PERJETA is a HER2/neu receptor antagonist indicated for use in combination with trastuzumab and chemotherapy as neoadjuvant treatment of patients with HER2-positive, locally advanced, inflammatory, or early stage breast cancer (either greater than 2 cm in diameter or node positive) as part of a complete treatment regimen for early breast cancer.

extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration granted approval to pertuzumab in combination with trastuzumab and chemotherapy for the neoadjuvant treatment patients with HER2-positive, locally advanced, inflammatory, or early stage breast cancer (either greater than 2 cm in diameter or node positive) as part of a complete treatment regimen for early breast cancer. This indication is based on Berenice (NCT02132949), a two-arm randomized study where HER2-positive was defined as a score of 3+ IHC or ISH amplification ratio of 2.0 or greater, as determined by a central laboratory. Patients received two potential chemotherapy regimens as part of the combination therapy: cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, and paclitaxel; or cyclophosphamide, docetaxel, epirubicin, and 5-fu.
